column1: # The stranger opener's coin, anchored on its own re-seed (`prng.md`
# Section 3, `conversation.md` Section 9 step 3): "the engine makes one fresh
# host-clock read, assigns the transformed value as the shared
# random-generator state, and immediately flips a fair coin". With a fixed
# DOS clock both sides re-seed to the same state right before the flip, so
# the two must agree on whether the NPC introduces itself, every run.
# At 12:00:00.00 the seed is `0x09EB` and the first draw is odd; its
# companion `reseed-stranger-coin-silent` runs the same seed and keys at
# 12:00:00.08 (seed `0x09E3`, an even first draw). Together they pin which
# coin value introduces - something the spec leaves as "one outcome" and
